newsitems.contents:
Hey Everyone,

This patch adds 3 buildable rafts along with a mooring post. Additionally there are new buildable holders for the KnightV and the hang glider. We also added a procedural defensive wall placement system so you can now just draw out where you want the walls and let Kelvin finish them. newsitems.title: Top-rated survival sim Sons of the Forest drops to its lowest-ever price
newsitems.contents: Sons of the Forest, a survival sim that traps you on a cannibal and mutant-infested island, is 50% off in Steam's Winter Sale. You'll need a strong stomach to deal with some of its horrors, but at $14.99 this 95% rated game is an absolute steal.
